venture_plan_compiler.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_factory_venture_plan.py
covers: byte-identical repeated compile
missing capability blocks plan and run
absent provider artifact is a capability gap
unsupported and invalid specifications are refused
materially different specs produce materially different plans
mission package_paths must cover the plan
every stage receipt binds the frozen plan digest

control_plane_port.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_control_plane_port.py
covers: ALLOW
DENY
UNKNOWN (no grant, unregistered principal, unregistered session)
unavailable (absent, malformed, self-reported offline, fail-open fixture)
CONFLICT (conflicting writer lease, conflicting grants, lease required, authority-reference mismatch)
workspace out of scope
denied stage stops the run and is receipted
packaging requires its own authority

receipt_output_drift.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_receipt_drift.py
covers: artifact changed after verification
receipt references a missing output
package differs from verified output
package archive tampered
handoff points at an obsolete artifact
handoff pins a superseded package receipt
unproven preview is reported, not assumed

preview_proof.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_preview_proof.py
covers: package extracted and launched with an allowlisted argv
health, identity and representative interaction probes
captured identifier spent on a later probe
identity mismatch fails the preview
a bare HTTP 200 does not satisfy an interaction probe
preview requires its own Control Plane authority
traversing archive member cannot escape the preview tree

transition_intelligence_proof.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_transition_proof.py
covers: the real venture spec compiles to a READY deterministic plan
product capabilities are derived from the specification
every committed receipt names the same artifact digest
every stage recorded an explicit Control Plane ALLOW
every reused capability resolves to an exact blob
